definition: Evidence or edge supports the scoped assurance claim or a required evidence element.
Evidence contradicts the claim or demonstrates a material service failure.
Evidence narrows the claim by population, geography, time, loadcase, or delivery channel.
Evidence is too old, unreviewed, or superseded for the current claim period.
Evidence has been replaced by a newer authority or record.
Evidence or claim is challenged by audit, complaint, litigation, community review, or contradictory data.
Evidence is out of scope for the claim or loadcase.
Claim effect has not yet been classified.
